name: Playwright
description: Installs the Playwright CLI with its browsers' OS dependencies, keeps downloaded browsers on the persistent volume, trusts local CAs in Chromium, and optionally adds a VNC desktop for headed browsers

version.description: Exact @playwright/cli version installed at image build time.

systemDeps.description: Comma-separated browsers whose OS packages are installed at build time: chromium, firefox, webkit. 'none' skips.

browsers.description: Comma-separated browsers downloaded on create for the CLI's bundled Playwright: chromium, firefox, webkit. The first becomes playwright-cli's default browser. 'none' skips.

trustLocalCAs.description: Import every CA under /usr/local/share/ca-certificates into the user's NSS database on each start, which Chromium reads instead of the system store.

desktop.description: Install a VNC/noVNC desktop for headed browsers, started on demand with playwright-desktop. Skipped on WSL, which has WSLg.

desktopPassword.description: VNC password for the desktop option.
